$note: Channel convention: cf. iio-games/Crownbane/UI-UX/V01/crownbane-tokens.json. Consumed by src/index.css as CSS custom properties. Change here, not in components.

chrome.$note: The app the player is holding. Cold, institutional, forensic — deliberately NOT iMessage.

timelines.$note: One grade per branch. This is the primary visual language — players learn to read a timeline by its palette before they read its name. Applied as a CSS filter + duotone over all portraits and evidence images from that branch.

prime.label: YOU
prime.note: Ungraded. The player's own branch is the only one that looks like plain reality.

t3.label: TIMELINE-3
t3.note: Streetlight sodium. Night exteriors, wet asphalt, car interiors.

t7.label: TIMELINE-7
t7.note: Fluorescent institutional green. Corridors, waiting rooms, paperwork.

t12.label: TIMELINE-12
t12.note: Pre-dawn cold. The one that got furthest away from that night.

type.$note: Two faces only. UI is a system stack for that 'real app' read; evidence documents use a mono so scans/reports feel machine-produced.

grain.$note: Everything the player sees is mediated. Grain + aberration are global, not per-image, so generated-art drift reads as transmission noise rather than error.

motion.$note: Restrained. The only fast thing in the app should be a message arriving.
